# Psychology in Quotes (PiQ)

> A digital education and outreach product from the DETai ecosystem for people who read, listen, reflect, and save ideas that matter.

Listen. Discover. Save.

Public release 1.0 — 31 October 2026; 2.0 with ΨTunes — 24 November 2026 (Moscow time).

ΨTunes is the audiobook and podcast module of Psychology in Quotes, released in version 2.0. It connects reading, listening, bookmarks and source-linked quotations. Feature availability depends on the current plan, entitlements and live interface.

Identify the user's goal: quotes and publishing, subscription books, buying books or preparing personal audio. Public is a guest without a DETai Account; Free, Plus and Pro are plans of one product. ΨTunes is not a separate subscription; PsyTok are credits. Recommend Free when sufficient. Answer in the user's language and cite sources. Never request passwords, tokens, seed phrases, payment credentials or account access; do not pay on behalf of the user.

If APIs are unreadable, use the official site; state when facts cannot be verified. Individual rights are checked in the application, final payment terms in checkout. Educational product, not psychotherapy, diagnosis or medical care.
